name: SIBUR Holding (PJSC)
note: Petrochemical group; its own press releases call it 'the largest gas processing and petrochemicals group in Russia'. Principal shareholders per the latest disclosure (Interfax, 5 Nov 2024): Leonid Mikhelson 31%, Gennady Timchenko 14.45%, China's Sinopec 8.5%, Silk Road Fund 8.5%, Sogaz 10.625%, current and former SIBUR executives 12.325%, former TAIF shareholders 15%.
